what: Play chapter 1 through at its gate, as a player would (loop from milestone-rev6-p3-rumors run-08, verbatim, with a stricter spot: the target must be nearer than anything else by half a tile): walk beside the nearest person not yet met or find not yet opened, A to talk or open, A through the lines until the dialogue closes; until the host clears e1. Then read met/found, the chapter.cleared deed, the carry

repeat.until: (async()=>{const s=await window.__e2e.state(); const t=await window.__e2e.nextTodo(); return !t || !s.nearby || s.nearby.id!==t.id})()

actions.eval: (async()=>{const S=await import('/state/index.ts'); const H=await import('/history/index.ts'); const p=S.useLandStore.getState().progress; const e=p.episodes.e1; const n=H.worldNow(); const deeds=Object.values(n.events).filter(r=>r.kind==='deed'); return JSON.stringify({ms: Date.now()-window.__e2e.t0, cleared:e.cleared, summary:e.summary ?? null, met:e.stage?.met, found:e.stage?.found, carry:p.storyCarry, deeds: deeds.map(d=>({label:d.label, where:d.where, pending:d.pending}))})})()
